title: Inside is 8 inches, not 9in. did not come with recipes as it said.
text:
Inside is 8 inches, not 9in. did not come with recipes as it said.. I’m a fairly new bread baker,(Sourdough) but I expected this to measure 9 inches inside at the top ,
It measures 8 inches on the side, which is disappointing to me, as I already have the 8 inch.
Also showed before I bought this, and said that recipe came with this, No it does Not.

False advertising is disappointing to me.
Giving this 2 stars for the other baking little things this comes with.
